    ┌─ wgsl:223:7
    │
223 │   let patch = fbm(uv.x * 8.0 + seed, uv.y * 8.0 - seed, 5.0) * 0.5 + 0.5;

thread '<unnamed>' panicked at library/core/src/panicking.rs:218:5:
panic in a function that cannot unwind
stack backtrace:
resolution: Fixed the WGSL crash from the grass-ground fix: fill_grass used 'patch' as a variable name (a WGSL reserved keyword) AND a backtick in a comment (which closed the JS template literal holding the WGSL string). Renamed the var to 'tone', removed the backtick. Re-bundled clean; rebuilt hmsc-int + self-shot PASS; rjit game shot PASS (the compiled heightfield material assembles the same fill, so it would have crashed there too). Root cause of the ground-color issue itself: grass tiles' surface.material is 'soil', and tileFillMaterialId mapped soil->sand fill (id 2, yellow), so the 3D ground painted grass with the sand shader while the 2D painter showed the green render.color. Added fill_grass (green lawn, matId 3) and routed all grass kinds to it (grassDry uses the drier variant 1).
